mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM stock_order WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND status IN ('SENDING','UNKNOWN','CANCEL_SENDING','CANCEL_UNKNOWN')
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_order SET status='SENDING',version=version+1,message='주문 전송 중 · 재전송 금지',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='PREVIEW' AND expires_at>now()

UPDATE stock_order SET status='CANCEL_SENDING',version=version+1,message='잔량 취소 요청 중',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('ACCEPTED','PARTIAL') AND remaining_quantity>0

UPDATE stock_order SET status=#{status},broker_order_id=#{brokerOrderId},broker_branch=#{brokerBranch},cancel_order_id=#{cancelOrderId},filled_quantity=#{filledQuantity},remaining_quantity=#{remainingQuantity},average_fill_price=#{averageFillPrice},message=#{message},version=version+1,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
